parameters.content:
# AI - Chat Completion

- Modular OpenAI-compatible chat-completions sub-workflow
- Input is API-near: messages are required, model is optional
- Route is selected by routingProfile: low, standard, high
- Each route has a primary URL/model and a fallback URL/model
- Runtime behavior: primary try -> primary retry -> fallback
- On fallback success, send a Telegram alert to the configured error recipient
- The final success output is the raw API response from the successful endpoint

Configuration notes:
1) Edit each route Set node to change URLs and models as plain text
2) Configure the provider-specific authentication directly in the HTTP Request nodes of the matching route
3) The Telegram recipient is configured in the global config Set node
4) Keep inputs OpenAI-compatible and pass additional top-level request fields through as needed

assignments.name: messages
assignments.value: [{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Reply with a short greeting."}]
